dynamic-element.dynamic-content:
The Liferay Customer Portal is your central hub for managing subscriptions, downloading software, opening support tickets, and tracking orders. Whether you are signing in for the first time or returning to check on an existing project, this article walks you through the essentials so you can make the most of your Liferay Support resources.

Signing In and Navigating the Dashboard

Sign in with your Liferay account to reach the dashboard, your starting point for everything the portal offers. From the top navigation you can jump to My Account to review project details and orders, to Support to open and track tickets, and to the Marketplace to browse apps and solutions. The account selector in the upper right lets you switch between the organizations you belong to.

Managing Your Team

Account administrators can invite colleagues, assign roles, and designate incident contacts from the Team Members area. Granting the right level of access ensures the people who need to open support tickets or manage subscriptions can do so, while keeping sensitive actions restricted to the appropriate roles.

Finding Help

If you run into trouble, the Support menu keeps tools and contact options within reach at all times. Browse the Customer Portal Help topics for step-by-step guidance, review the support policies to understand expected response times, or open a ticket to reach the Liferay Support team directly.
